_comment: Verifier profiles. argv runs with shell=False, isolated interpreter (-I), sanitized env, in a temporary detached checkout of the EXACT revision. Before running, the candidate is diffed against the job base: changes to protected_paths, changes outside editable_paths (allowlist), interpreter/test-runner hook files (sitecustomize, usercustomize, *.pth, conftest.py, pytest/tox/setup config) and top-level modules shadowing stdlib or verifier modules are rejected. Only the exit status decides. Any profile or referenced script containing OMO_VERIFY_TEMPLATE fails closed.

example-template-do-not-use._comment: Copy and replace with a real project test command. While the marker is present this profile fails closed.
